name: solace-topology
description: Open-source Solace PubSub+ topology map proof of concept.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @solace-topology/api" "npm run dev -w @solace-topology/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && npm run build -w @solace-topology/api && npm run build -w @solace-topology/web
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/prepare-pages-demo.mjs && VITE_STATIC_DEMO=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/solace-topology/ npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && VITE_STATIC_DEMO=true VITE_BASE_PATH=/solace-topology/ npm run build -w @solace-topology/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && npm run test -w @solace-topology/shared && npm run test -w @solace-topology/api && npm run test -w @solace-topology/web
scripts.test:live-brokers: npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && npm run build -w @solace-topology/api && node scripts/live-broker-smoke.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @solace-topology/shared && npm run typecheck -w @solace-topology/api && npm run typecheck -w @solace-topology/web
